summary: Stage 5 (campaigns + offers + growth tracker + content) verified end-to-end. 20/20 backend pytest cases pass; full Playwright UI walkthrough of /campaigns and /settings/offers also passes. All 13 audiences present with correct tab grouping (5/3/5), predicate counts match spec (ota_conversion_medium=3, high_value_direct=2 [Mary+Tom], single_stay_ota=5), sort orders correct, CSV export has the right 14 columns + filename pattern, growth tracker default target=40 with PUT persistence verified, offers CRUD + empty-code 400 + content GET/PUT all behave as specified, and Stages 1-4.5 endpoints remain 200 OK.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1350 lines — getting heavy; consider splitting Stage 5 routes into a dedicated router module (campaigns_router.py) alongside campaign_service.py.

PUT /api/settings/offers/{code} ignores body 'code' (overwrites with path code) — current behaviour is correct but undocumented; consider returning 409 if body.code != path code or document the override.
settings_offers_post upserts on existing code without distinguishing create vs update — POST on an existing code silently mutates. Minor REST nit; not blocking.

growth_tracker windowing: three_months_ago_pct uses [3,6] months and six_months_ago_pct uses [6,9] — labels in UI say '3 months ago' / '6 months ago' which is accurate, but worth confirming the product intent (sliding 3-month windows vs. point-in-time).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing sample DB (10 reservations, ~10 guests).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Stage 5 endpoints + UI verified. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_stage5_campaigns.py covers campaigns shape, predicates, sorting, CSV columns, 404s, growth tracker, target PUT/restore, offer CRUD, content GET/PUT, and regression for prior stages.
